snippet.title: Immortal's Way - Demo Trailer
snippet.description:
One small rabbit. Twelve ancient guardians. A boss-focused action game rooted in Chinese mythology. Study their patterns, strike with precision, and explore Penglai, the Isle of Immortals.

Play Steam demo for free: https://store.steampowered.com/app/2986350/Immortals_Way/

Made by 2-person indie team Mark & Xin from Final Final Studios, formerly at Harmonix and Google and creators of VR game Black Hat Cooperative.
